reviews.comment:
Como la mayoría de las YPF los playeros tardan en atender , no te limpian el parabrisas,  cuando pagué con la aplicación le pedí que me explicara como hacer con los puntos y se quedó mirando su celular,  en el Shop las empleadas poca atención, tuve que esperar como 10 minutos mientras charlaban entre ellas, excepto una que estaba limpiando los vidrios,  vino me atendió muy bien

(Translated by Google)
Like most YPF stations, the attendants are slow to serve you, they don't clean your windshield, and when I paid with the app, I asked them to explain how to use the points, but they just stared at their phone. In the shop, the employees were inattentive; I had to wait about 10 minutes while they chatted amongst themselves, except for one who was cleaning the windows. She came and served me very well.
